description:
About the Fellowship

Northwestern's Nicholson Fellowship supports outstanding current PhD students in science, engineering and management. Applications are by internal university programme nomination, not open external applications. Northwestern University is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on Dr John N Nicholson PhD Fellowship, Northwestern 2027. Disciplinary scope: Engineering. Location: Evanston, United States. Full funding is provided; financial support is listed as Stipend/salary rate set by the funder — see the official listing. Applications close 11 January 2027.

Who Can Be Nominated

This internal award is restricted to US citizens enrolled in Northwestern PhD programmes, normally in their second, third or fourth year. It is not an open international admission scholarship.

About the Fellowship

Northwestern's Nicholson Fellowship supports outstanding current PhD students in science, engineering and management. It is an internal graduate award providing nine months of stipend support and tuition payment, with a separate reference deadline. Northwestern University is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on Dr John N Nicholson PhD Fellowship, Northwestern 2027. Research areas covered include Engineering. Location: Evanston, United States. Full funding is provided; financial support is listed as Stipend/salary rate set by the funder — see the official listing. The stated deadline is 11 January 2027.

Research Areas

  • Sciences
  • Engineering
  • Management research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionInternal doctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryFull tuition and nine months of stipend at the University Fellowship rate; one-year internal award.
DurationNine months

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement

Application dates

ComponentDetails

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.northwestern.edu/tgs/funding/fellowships-and-grants/internal-fellowships-grants/dr-john-n-nicholson-fellowship.html

Source: northwestern.edu - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 11 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Review the eligibility criteria carefully; applications outside the stated scope are usually rejected at the first screening stage.

How to Apply

  1. Confirm your eligibility as a current doctoral student and review the internal award requirements.
  2. Follow the university’s nomination process and arrange the supporting materials requested by your programme.
  3. Complete the internal submission by the nomination deadline and arrange reference submissions where required.

About Northwestern University

Northwestern offers doctoral programmes through its graduate schools. The Nicholson Fellowship is an internal award for selected PhD students and uses the university's nomination and application process.
